scope: workflow state transitions and authoritative storage access
exclusions: observatory and presentation reads remain outside the write kernel
no second Todo transaction kernel may remain after qualified forwarding

external_authorities.name: git
external_authorities.authority: the Git repository and Git transport
external_authorities.boundary: Git and worktree effects are external side effects, never SQLite-atomic workflow transitions.

external_authorities.name: host_resources
external_authorities.authority: the host scheduler, operating system, and resource providers
external_authorities.boundary: Workflow records intents and observed receipts; it does not claim host-resource authority.

external_authorities.name: compiler_artifacts
external_authorities.authority: the compiler toolchain and its artifact store
external_authorities.boundary: Compiler outputs and caches are external artifacts, not authoritative workflow state.

prohibited_changes: No relocation of .todo-orchestrator state paths, UUIDs, history, caches, sessions, credentials, or compiled artifacts.
No schema, revision-event sequencing, graph, readiness, capability, workspace, integration, recovery, or lifecycle semantic change is a relocation exception.
A known baseline bug remains baseline behavior until a separately scoped feature change.
